newsitem.title: USA: Perini gets $280 million contract for Las Vegas hotel.
newsitem.headline: Perini gets $280 million contract for Las Vegas hotel.

text.p: Perini Corp. said Wednesday it was awarded a $280 million contract to build a new 29-level hotel tower, with a Roman theme, for ITT Corp.'s Caesars Palace in Las Vegas, Nev.

The hotel would contain 1,132 guest rooms and 49 suites, a convention area, meeting rooms, ballrooms, and a spa and fitness facility. The project was expected to be completed in December 1997, said Perini, an international construction company headquartered in Framingham, Ma.
